mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a balmy seventy-three degrees under a pitch-black new moon over Harriet Park tonight. Talk about a sticky Wisconsin summer night! There are no space station sightings, so do not bother looking up. In city news, local students have until July twenty-second to submit designs for the I Voted sticker contest. In police news, an officer tried to stop a motorcycle without a license plate, but the driver fled at high speeds through red lights. Finally, Culver's is closed right now but opens in the morning at ten AM. Sleep tight and dream of tomorrow's Snickers Swirl flavor!
